steps.code:
# Get all songs in the song library
access_token = login_response['access_token']
all_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total songs in library: {len(all_songs)}")
print(all_songs[:2])
